tools.name: bioai_ask
tools.description: Ask BioAI, the Biomiv health research agent, about a health condition, symptom or goal (or about the Biomiv site). Returns its answer as text with the link for the person: what the research relates to the condition and the diet engineered for it. Free, no account needed. Research information, not me

tools.name: get_engineered_diet
tools.description: The diet the BIOMIC-42 algorithm engineered for a condition: the body processes behind the condition, what is reported to work against each, the suggested combination with its 0-100 score, recipes and citations. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

tools.name: get_research_cards
tools.description: Research cards for a condition: foods, micronutrients, plant compounds, drug compounds, genes and proteins, each with what it addresses, its evidence and its citations, plus repurposed drug candidates. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

tools.name: get_clinical_trials
tools.description: Clinical trials for a condition, read live from the public trials registry: most recently updated first, with the registry's total. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

tools.name: get_healthspan_meter
tools.description: The healthspan meter for a condition's diet: years of life associated with its foods and nutrients, worked out from published studies of each item and death from any cause, with the sentence each number came from. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

tools.name: get_molecular_view
tools.description: The molecular view for a condition: one compound and one protein it acts on, with the three-dimensional structure on record (an experimental structure of the two together, or the protein's predicted model). Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

tools.name: get_research_news
